Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1060
Claimant:
Jacqueline Martin
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
3-3-25
First notice of loss came in from the policyholder's household member, who reported a sideswipe while changing
lanes on a multi-lane road. The claimant reported a knee injury and said they were not represented by counsel.
3-18-25
Spoke with the claimant by phone. They described the same sequence as the first report: the other vehicle drifted into
their lane as they were merging, and their side panels made contact. They gave the same account of the impact
without prompting.
3-26-25
Obtained the police report. The officer's notes place the claimant outside the vehicle when the collision occurred,
which conflicts with the claimant's own statement and needs to be clarified before any injury evaluation is finalized.
3-29-25
Reviewed photos from the scene and the other driver's statement. Both show contact along the right side of the
vehicle, consistent with the described impact. A witness statement also describes the collision as the claimant
reported it, though the witness did not see who was inside the vehicle.
7-21-25
Inspected the vehicle. The damage pattern matches the impact described by the claimant and the other driver. No
prior body damage or repairs to the same area were found in the records or on inspection, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the coverage start.
7-31-25
Requested medical records. The knee injury is the kind expected from a force of this type. Treatment has continued
somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and the file shows no earlier problems with the same knee.
8-3-25
Confirmed with the policy records that the driver involved lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household
member under the policy. Coverage applies to the driver for this loss, subject to the open question about the
claimant's location at the time of the crash.
9-6-25
Followed up with the claimant again to address the officer's and witness's accounts about their position at impact. The
claimant repeated their original account, and the file remains open pending the medical review and that clarification.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
